content.summary: Illustrative plan: test whether a first-time user can recover task context after returning from a secondary domain. No participant observations supplied.
content.method: Observe a representative task on mobile and desktop; record participant role, device, steps, outcome, and recovery attempts. High risk because state loss could prevent completion.
limitations: No participant or human observation has been supplied; task success remains unverified.
